scope: Static public-API and call-site audit of both optical libraries and freemkv-flash adapters; not a firmware-handler safety proof or completed cleanup
status: Protocol detection implementation in progress; other findings are recommendations, not claimed fixes

findings.title: Identity is parsed data, not protocol proof
findings.recommendation: Keep legacy Identity accessors compatible; add protocol::Evidence with private construction, explicit incomplete errors and parsed Identity access. Do not add a second drive-name classifier.

findings.title: Discovery and receiver detection use different evidence
findings.recommendation: One app discovery orchestration; library response parsers; receiver detection remains deeper firmware/ABI validation. Remove vendor shortcuts from discovery and audit recovery separately.

findings.title: identify APIs hide or conflate evidence failures
findings.recommendation: Optional field read errors are currently collapsed to empty bytes/default identity. Preserve per-query failures in discovery; keep compatibility adapters for presentation.

findings.title: Boolean targets hides why identity differs
findings.recommendation: Expose structured identity facts, then apply named binding/startup policies. Exact bytes, platform, naming, tags and operating state are independent. Do not globally relax receiver binding.

findings.title: Comparison APIs cover different representations
findings.recommendation: Share fact types/adapters where useful; retain explicit distinctions between exact decoded bytes, normalized executable similarity, family and version direction. Envelope::compare is not an update compatibility decision.

findings.title: Family identity loses namespace in adapters
findings.recommendation: Carry typed family scheme and value until serialization. Remove surrogate current-pioneer namespaces when adapters can preserve the real scheme. Missing family is never a match.

findings.title: Completion receipts differ between vendors and app
findings.recommendation: Return component readback and coverage plus startup evidence with failures; avoid reconstructing the only durable result from callbacks. Keep progress callbacks as presentation.

findings.title: Several public execution layers need clear entry points
findings.recommendation: Document prepared receiver execution as the normal host API. Low-level CDB/session APIs remain expert tools with explicit contracts. These are layers, not automatically duplicate algorithms.

findings.title: Standard MMC types live under the Pioneer namespace
findings.recommendation: Display DTO is legitimate, but standard INQUIRY parsing should have one owner. Prefer an existing transport/MMC layer if suitable; avoid a new shared crate solely for a few fields.

findings.title: Semantic API terms need separation
findings.recommendation: Use inquiry/device identity for live reports, firmware identity for package metadata, protocol evidence for recognition, receiver for update ABI, and typed family for compatibility. Keep 1.0.x changes additive.

findings.title: Low-level count validation is inconsistent
findings.recommendation: drive::read clamps oversized reported lengths, while Device::read rejects them. Audit transport count contracts before consolidating; add fault-injection tests before changing established semantics.

migration: Additive 1.0.x APIs; preserve existing public entry points as compatibility adapters; no silent changes to receiver, ABI or verification policy.
validation: Baseline core: 632 passed/18 ignored. Baseline optical libraries green. ASUS regression reproduced before detector changes. Full after suites required; no release with known regression.
